audit.whatIsWrong: Two-layer chart disagreement at the last two rows: full phases[5].side and phases[6].side both said 'Skill' while content win[5] and win[6] both said 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart gives Aurelion Sol both stages and both full whys already argue for him ('your E executes the back line of every wave', 'You are the scaling endgame'). Annie's entire threat is a 600-625 range window that stops growing; the beam does not.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side move to 'Aurelion Sol'. Rows 0-4 left alone — packet, content and prose already agree on Annie.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] say Tibbers is 'a second stun source'. Tibbers does not stun. Riot's R text is damage in the area plus a bear that attacks and burns nearby enemies — nothing else.
audit.why: The stun at level 6 comes from Pyromania: after four casts her next offensive spell stuns, and Summon: Tibbers is an offensive spell, so the R cast carries the stun when the passive is stocked. A player told 'Tibbers stuns' will misread which cast to dodge.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to attribute the stun to Pyromania and the AoE/burn to Tibbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late spike was described as a 'global Comet presence' and 'global presence and 5-star Comet ultimate'.
audit.why: Reworked Aurelion Sol has no Comet and no global ultimate; Falling Star / The Skies Descend is 1250 range.
audit.corrected: whys[6], spikes[3] and content late rewritten around the beam and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range gap that decides this lane was never stated. Breath of Light and the black hole are both 750; Annie's longest offensive ability is Disintegrate at 625, Incinerate is 600 and Summon: Tibbers is 600.
audit.why: She has to close 125 units into the beam to touch you at all, and Aurelion Sol has no reason ever to close that distance himself. It is the whole positional rule of the matchup and the page instead gave generic 'stay out of his engage range' filler.
audit.corrected: Stated in tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.carry, report[5] and content early.
sources: enemyKit Q range 625, W range 600, R range 600

audit.whatIsWrong: Pyromania's actual trigger was stated wrongly in wants.foe[0] ('Auto-attack you to load Pyromania') and vaguely in content early ('every four spells or autos').
audit.why: Riot's P text: 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.' Autos do not load it. Counting her four casts is the only tell, and Disintegrate refunds its own mana on a kill — so she stocks the passive for free while last-hitting.
audit.corrected: Corrected in wants.foe[0], content early, breakdown.early and dosFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit Q text (mana refund on kill)

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield's reflect was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's E text: it 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells'. Breath of Light is a multi-second channel of repeated spell damage, so burning a shielded Annie feeds the reflect for the whole duration — a reason to break the channel rather than greed it.

Summon: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1 and only 600 range; Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1; Falling Star 120s. And the number that matters most is not a cooldown at all — it is the four casts that arm Pyromania.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the Tibbers, Astral Flight and four-cast numbers.

notes: Two real factual errors fixed beyond the usual template work. (1) Tibbers was credited with a stun in whys[4] and spikes[1]; it has none — the level 6 stun is Pyromania riding the R cast. (2) wants.foe[0] and content early said Pyromania loads off auto-attacks; Riot's text is 'After casting 4 spells', so autos do not load it and the tell is her four casts, not her attacks. Combined with Disintegrate refunding its mana on a kill, she arms the passive for free while last-hitting, which is why 'count the casts' is the whole early game. The 'Comet' / 'global ultimate' pre-rework language appears here again in whys[6], spikes[0], spikes[3] and late — that is now four of four matchups in my slice, so it is systemic across this champion's content file rather than a one-off. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Pyromania's stun can be baited onto a ward (I wrote 'onto a minion' only, which the kit supports since Disintegrate and Incinerate both hit minions); whether Molten Shield's reflect procs per beam tick or once (Riot's text does not say, so I wrote that it hurts you for striking her with spells without claiming a rate); tenacity/QSS behaviour on either stun.
